name: Classic haircut
description: A clean cut with scissors and clipper, finished with a hot towel. Walk-ins welcome, but booking avoids the Friday queue.

name: Beard shaping
description: Trim, line-up and shape of the beard, with a light oil to finish.

name: Hair colouring
description: Full colour or highlights with a patch test beforehand. Bring a photo of the shade you want.

name: Home deep cleaning
description: Kitchen, bathrooms, floors and windows for an apartment of up to three rooms. Products included.

name: Plumbing repair visit
description: Leaks, blocked drains, taps and toilets. The visit fee covers the first hour; parts are extra.

name: Electrician visit
description: Sockets, switches, lights and fuse-box checks. Safety first: the electrician tests everything before leaving.

name: Sofa and carpet cleaning
description: Deep steam cleaning for sofas and carpets, with stain treatment. Dry in about four hours.

name: Phone screen repair
description: Screen replacement for most popular phones while you wait. Three-month warranty on the part.

name: Laptop clean and tune-up
description: Dust removal, new thermal paste, system clean-up and updates. Your laptop runs cooler and faster.

name: Home Wi-Fi setup
description: Router placement, signal test and a secure password. We also check the weak corners of your home.

name: Private maths lesson
description: One-to-one maths for middle and high school, with exercises matched to the student's programme.

name: English conversation class
description: Relaxed speaking practice in small groups. Focus on confidence, not grammar rules.

name: Web development lesson
description: HTML, CSS and JavaScript from zero, building a real page in every session.

name: Birthday photo session
description: Two hours of candid and group photos, with 40 edited pictures delivered within a week.

name: DJ for a small party
description: Four hours of music for up to 60 guests. Speakers and basic lights included.
